Class EndTurnPhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.phase.EndTurnPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhase
public class EndTurnPhase extends Object implements GamePhase
A transient resolution phase triggered at the end of every round.

This phase does not require direct player input. It automatically executes the end-of-round bookkeeping mechanics, which include resolving active events, shifting the board cards, incrementing the turn counter, and determining whether the game continues to the next round or transitions to the final scoring phase.

  • Method Details

    • endTurn

      public List<GameDelta> endTurn(Game game)
      Executes the comprehensive end-of-turn logic and resolves the game state.

      The resolution order strictly follows the game rules:

      1. Applies special end-game rules (e.g., registering upper row events on turn 10).
      2. Triggers all active event effects via the Notificator Center.
      3. Advances the board (shifting rows, refilling cards) unless it's the final turn.
      4. Increments the turn counter and determines the next state (Place Totem vs. End Game).
      Parameters:
      game - the main game instance being updated
      Returns:
      a list of network deltas containing the massive board and resource synchronization

    • toSnapshot

      public PhaseSnapshot toSnapshot()
      Serializes this phase into a lightweight data transfer object.

      Note: Because this is a transient phase that resolves immediately, its snapshot is mostly symbolic and cannot be actively restored during a crash recovery.

      Specified by:
      toSnapshot in interface GamePhase
      Returns:
      an EndTurnPhaseSnapshot
